patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width content blocks and split layouts (image/illustration on one side, text/features on the other), often with a centered content container.
A dominant palette of deep forest greens, light greens, and white, accented by a warm, bright yellow for calls to action and subtle beige tones in illustrations.

The large hero illustration features a subtle parallax effect, where the background elements (mountains, sky) scroll slower than the foreground elements (road, trees), creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls down.
The site heavily utilizes custom, stylized illustrations as primary visual elements in hero sections and feature blocks, giving a distinct brand character.
Headings use a bold, modern sans-serif with significant size variation, while body text is a highly readable, clean sans-serif, ensuring clear hierarchy and legibility.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a layered illustration where background elements are animated to move at a slower rate than the scroll speed, creating a parallax effect. Foreground content scrolls normally over this background.
The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport upon scroll, maintaining its transparent background, allowing underlying content to show through.
Sections are revealed as the user scrolls, with content appearing to simply scroll into view without complex fade-in or slide-up animations, relying on the parallax hero for primary motion interest.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, with the hero heading being exceptionally large (~4-5x body) and prominent, establishing a clear visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are applied consistently to buttons, input fields, and card elements, softening the overall aesthetic without being overly playful.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with generous vertical spacing between major sections, creating an airy feel, while content within cards and feature blocks is more tightly packed for efficiency.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its use of large-scale, custom-illustrated landscapes, particularly the hero section's parallax mountain scene. This creates a unique, memorable brand identity that feels both natural and sophisticated, setting it apart from typical SaaS marketing sites.
